headline: Repairs at Winter Hill Innovation School and exterior tiles at Somerville High School are on the agenda.
summary: Items include bathroom and plumbing repairs at Winter Hill Innovation School and a request to use electric leaf blowers during school hours. Updates on the MSBA process for the Winter Hill and Brown Schools are also listed.
items: Use electric leaf blowers on school grounds during school hours, for children with sensory sensitivities. Sent by Councilor Link.
Immediately repair 'The Blaster' urinal fixture at Winter Hill Innovation School, with written work timelines. Sent by Councilor Strezo.
Repair broken plumbing, appliances, and privacy treatments in Winter Hill Innovation School bathrooms, with written work timelines. Sent by Councilor Strezo.
Update on when the school buildings maintenance project website will be available. Referred by Councilor Sait.
Presentation on continued concerns about exterior tiles on the Somerville High School building, and measures to address them. Referred by Councilor Davis.
Regular updates on the Massachusetts School Building Authority (MSBA) process for the Winter Hill and Brown Schools. Sent by Councilor Link and Councilor Mbah.
